US Attorney Todd Blanche's Political Appearances Draw Scrutiny

Todd Blanche, a US Attorney, has drawn criticism for appearing at political events, a move described as a "seismic shift" that breaks with Department of Justice (DOJ) norms. Attorneys general have traditionally maintained a distance from political rallies and the White House. The coverage highlights concerns about boundaries and the potential politicization of the DOJ. Blanche's actions are seen by some as a departure from established practices.
